measurement.boundary: client-observed resources during one page load; excludes server infrastructure, network embodied emissions and device energy

legacy_bytes.note: Historical bytes/co2g/energyWh retain this basis. Content-Length is usually encoded; the fallback body length is decoded. This is not a pure transfer-size measurement.

resource_timing.note: Resource Timing transferSize is actual network transfer when available; zero can mean cache or cross-origin restriction.

co2.basis: modelled estimate from the legacy page-byte total; not measured emissions

energy.basis: model-derived from CO2 / grid intensity; not observed client energy

limitations: No server-side, network-embodied or device energy measurement.
Cross-origin resources may report zero transfer size without Timing-Allow-Origin.
CO2.js output is an estimate, not a measured carbon quantity.

measurement.boundary: Resource Timing entries from one page load; the HTML navigation document is excluded, as are server infrastructure and device energy.
limitations: Cross-origin resources may report zero or unavailable size without Timing-Allow-Origin.
Resource keys strip query strings; distinct query variants are not separated.
Presence does not establish component ownership or a performance defect.
